title: Interactive Graphics with Plotly (Python)
text:
What is Plotly?

An open-source library for interactive charts, built on the JavaScript library plotly.js
The same engine powers Plotly for Python, R, and Julia, so the charts look and behave the same everywhere
Every figure is a small web page: hover, zoom, pan, and download come for free
Figures render inside notebooks, Quarto documents, and standalone HTML files
Two Python interfaces:

plotly.express (px): one function call per chart, works directly on data frames
plotly.graph_objects (go): build a figure trace by trace for full control

Install with conda install plotly or pip install plotly

Your first interactive plot

Drag to zoom into a region; double-click to reset
Use the toolbar (top right) to pan, zoom, or save a PNG
